description: Emotion battery. Every other case leaves bbCooked at its default of 1, which makes CChatDoc::ProcessLine skip ChatPreSendText (chatdoc.cpp:480) - and that is the ONLY path that runs GetEmotionsFromString -> GetBodyFromEmotion -> UpdateBody. So the whole text->emotion->pose pipeline was bypassed corpus-wide and every pose was a neutral. This case sets bbCooked: 0 so the rules actually fire: caps->SHOUT, !!!, greetings->WAVE, I/You->POINT, LOL/ROTFL, smileys. Driven as a sequence because GetBodyFromEmotion carries m_lastBody/Face/Torso history between messages (Tier-1 #2, Tier-3 #7). Seed differs from the 42 that 001-010 share.
